content.title: World Baseball Classic watch guide: USA vs. Venezuela in gripping championship game
content.text: The World Baseball Classic is a case for its sport as universality, a shared romance language coded in throws and swings. The 2026 installment has delivered on all fronts. Onward to a final matchup that crackles with tension.The United States takes on Venezuela for the WBC title, more than two months after a U.S. military incursion into Venezuela. Miami hosts a flush of fans from both sides. These ballclubs come in with feverish momentum after the semifinals, and MLB All-Stars dot each lineup card. Here’s what to know ahead of Tuesday’s first pitch.Your browser does not support the video tag.How to watch USA vs. Venezuela in WBC championship Venue: loanDepot Park — Miami Time: 8 p.m. ET, Tuesday TV: Fox, Fox Deportes Streaming: Fubo (Stream Free Now) Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. Fox is free over the air, and it also streams with a Fox One subscription.The names to know on the broadcast Joe Davis takes play-by-play. John Smoltz is on color commentary. This duo has narrated the World Series since 2022, when Davis succeeded Joe Buck in the Fox booth. The Athletic’s own Ken Rosenthal reports from the field.The studio show is stacked — Derek Jeter, Alex Rodriguez and David Ortiz are on-site in Miami, alongside Kevin Burkhardt as the anchor. Pregame programming begins at 7 p.m. ET, one hour before the game starts.Each team’s path to the championshipUSATeam USA arrived with perhaps its most hyped lineup ever. It opened pool play in style as it hung 15 runs on Brazil and nine on Great Britain. Despite its 5-3 win versus Mexico in the third leg, the U.S. had yet to clinch a quarterfinal spot — which may or may not have been news to manager Mark DeRosa. The Americans fell to then-unbeaten Italy in their fourth game, but they still advanced from the group stage thanks to a tiebreaker.In the quarterfinals, Brice Turang went 2-for-3 and tallied his fifth RBI of the WBC. The U.S. built up a 5-0 lead over Canada, then survived a late push to win 5-3.The semifinal showdown with the Dominican Republic was one for the ages. It included a wall-scaling home run robbery and a stunning final call in a 2-1 finish. Gunnar Henderson and Roman Anthony ripped solo homers. Starting pitcher Paul Skenes and the American relievers quelled the field’s most prolific offense.Thus far, Kyle Schwarber paces the U.S. with eight hits in 22 at-bats (.364), while the 21-year-old Anthony leads in runs produced. Anthony, Henderson, Aaron Judge and Pete Crow-Armstrong have two home runs apiece. David Bednar, Mason Miller and Clay Holmes have combined to throw 11 scoreless innings in relief.Nolan McLean gets the start on Tuesday. He’s No. 15 on The Athletic’s top 100 prospect board. The right-hander gave up two homers in three innings during last Tuesday’s loss to Italy.Team USA is one win from its second gold-medal triumph. It’s also on the verge of WBC redemption, an arc that began with its stinging loss in the 2023 final.VenezuelaOmar López’s club jumped out of Pool D play with comfortable defeats of the Netherlands, Israel and Nicaragua. Like the U.S., Venezuela was 3-0 in the group stage before it lost its fourth game, a 7-5 stumble to the Dominican Republic.The quarterfinals pitted Venezuela against Samurai Japan, reigning WBC champion and tournament powerhouse. Unfazed by Yoshinobu Yamamoto, the Venezuelans were boosted by a leadoff long ball from Ronald Acuña Jr. Maikel Garcia launched a two-run homer in the fifth inning, and Wilyer Abreu completely swung the game with his three-run, sixth-inning swat.Through three frames, Venezuela was in a 2-0 hole in its semifinal duel with Italy. Eugenio Suárez turned up the volume with a solo shot in the fourth. Then came the decisive stretch of three consecutive RBI singles, off the bats of Acuña, Garcia and Luis Arráez. Six Venezuelan relievers stitched together 23 outs without allowing a score.Acuña has zipped along the basepath to score 10 runs in six WBC games. Arráez, one of Major League Baseball’s last true singles hitters, is somehow slugging a team-best .783. Other MLB notables on Team Venezuela include 24-year-old Ezequiel Tovar, 22-year-old Jackson Chourio and eventual Hall of Fame candidate Salvador Perez.Southpaw Eduardo Rodriguez is slated to start for Venezuela. Just as McLean did, Rodriguez struggled in his prior start. The D.R. tagged him for two homers and three earned runs last Wednesday.Venezuela has never made it this far in the World Baseball Classic. It was eliminated by the U.S. in the 2023 quarterfinals, thanks to Trea Turner’s comeback-completing grand slam.Past WBC championship game results2006: Japan 10, Cuba 6. Ichiro Suzuki scored three runs, while Daisuke Matsuzaka notched his third win of the tournament.2009: Japan 5, South Korea 3. The game went to a 10th inning, where Suzuki delivered the two-out, go-ahead RBIs.2013: Dominican Republic 3, Puerto Rico 0. Samuel Deduno started the shutout and Fernando Rodney slammed the door.2017: USA 8, Puerto Rico 0. Marcus Stroman blanked the opposition across six innings.2023: Japan 3, USA 2. It famously ended with Shohei Ohtani striking out then-teammate Mike Trout.USA vs. Venezuela updated oddsTeam USA is currently a considerable -280 favorite to win the highly anticipated matchup. Basically, the odds imply about a 74 percent chance of the Americans winning. On the flip side, Venezuela’s moneyline odds sit at +220.
